q1_issues.issue: thief_of_time is a coined compound emitted with no decomposition atoms — Compound concepts requires the genus (Inheritance thief_of_time thief), and the closest licensed analogue (the kind-level fused adjective+complement, sensitive_to_light) also requires the argument atom (Of thief_of_time time).

q2_gaps: kind-level NOMINAL predicate taking an of-complement ("are thieves of time"): the fuse-and-decompose rule of Complements of nouns and adjectives is stated only for an ADJECTIVE with a bare-kind complement, and the entity-attached-oblique route needs an individuated noun symbol that a kind-level predicate does not supply
figurative / proverbial predication — a metaphorical predicate nominal has no treatment, so the proverb is recorded as an ordinary empirical generic
notes: Subject side is right: bare plural generic on the kind, empirical TV 0.9 0.9, and no QuantifierPhrase companion since no quantifier word is present. The only concrete defect is the undecomposed compound.
